d-s1.title: Northwind quality dossier
pages: Page 1 — Incoming inspection uses AQL 1.0 sampling on connectors and PCB lots.
Page 2 — Traceability is lot-plus-reel. Nonconforming material is quarantined within 4 hours.
Page 3 — Corrective actions from the last four quarters closed in 18 days on average.

d-s3.title: Atlas mill certificate pack
pages: Page 1 — Heat 4419 chemistry is within AMS 5643 limits for 17-4PH.
Page 2 — Tensile and hardness results exceed the purchase specification by 6%.
Page 3 — Export classification is EAR99. Certificates are valid for 24 months.

d-s5.title: Vesper SDS extract
pages: Page 1 — Product is a flammable solvent blend stored under nitrogen.
Page 2 — Occupational exposure limit is 25 ppm TWA. Local exhaust is required.
Page 3 — Waste must be handled as hazardous. Spill kits are staged at each dock.
